<function name="IsTyping" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether the player is typing in their chat.

This may not work properly if the server uses a custom chatbox.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the player is typing in their chat or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
